Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Interface TextEditorExtension

All Known Implementing Classes:
Base64Tools, BuiltinTextTools, CaseTools, CodeTools, CommentTools, FormatTools, GradleBuildTools, HashTools, JavaCompletionTools, JavaDebugTools, JavaDevTools, JavaDiagnosticsTools, JavaStructureTools, JsonTools, JvmBuildTools, MandelaTools, MarkdownTools, MavenBuildTools, SnippetsTools, SpringBootTools, TextStatsTool, TodoScanTools, WebTools
public interface TextEditorExtension
The Text Editor extension SPI. Developers implement this interface and register the implementation with META-INF/services (either on the application classpath for a built-in, or inside a jar dropped into ~/.lg3d/texteditor/extensions for a third-party extension); the editor discovers it with ServiceLoader.

Every hook except manifest() has a sensible default, so an extension implements only the behaviour it needs. Hooks are invoked by the ExtensionBroker on the EDT and are individually guarded: an extension that throws is logged and skipped without disturbing the editor or the other extensions.

Capabilities are gated on the permissions the user granted in the extension manager; see EditorContext.

  • Method Details

    • manifest

      TextEditorManifest manifest()
      Returns:
      this extension's identity, blurb and required permissions; never null

    • category

      default String category()
      The human-readable group this extension's toolbar actions are filed under in the extension manager (for example "Text", "Code", "Java/Kotlin", "Web"). The editor uses it only to group the contributed actions; it never gates behaviour. Blank or null values are normalised to "General".
      Returns:
      the category label; "General" by default

    • onEditorStarted

      default void onEditorStarted(EditorContext ctx)
      Called once on the EDT after the editor is up and this extension is enabled, with a capability facade scoped to the granted permissions.
      Parameters:
      ctx - the editor capability facade

    • onEditorStopping

      default void onEditorStopping(EditorContext ctx)
      Called on the EDT when the editor is shutting down, so the extension can release resources.
      Parameters:
      ctx - the editor capability facade

    • onDocumentOpened

      default void onDocumentOpened(DocumentContext doc)
      Called after a document is opened or a new tab is created. Requires TextEditorPermission.READ; write operations through DocumentContext require TextEditorPermission.WRITE.
      Parameters:
      doc - the loaded document

    • onDocumentChanged

      default void onDocumentChanged(DocumentContext doc)
      Called on the EDT after the current document's text has changed, debounced to the editor's idle timer (so it does not fire on every keystroke) and re-fired once the user switches tabs. Requires TextEditorPermission.READ. Live analysis extensions (diagnostics, structure) refresh here.
      Parameters:
      doc - the changed document, with the current caret/selection geometry

    • onDocumentSaved

      default void onDocumentSaved(DocumentContext doc)
      Called after a document is saved. Requires TextEditorPermission.READ.
      Parameters:
      doc - the saved document

    • toolbarContributions

      default List<ToolbarContribution> toolbarContributions()
      Toolbar buttons this extension contributes. Requires TextEditorPermission.TOOLBAR; rendered on the EDT.
      Returns:
      the contributions, empty by default
